images.title: Onion prices month by month
images.purpose: Show both towns' onion prices as a double column graph so month by month comparisons can be read.
images.composition: One double column graph filling the frame, months along the bottom, price up the side, legend at the top.
exact_structure: A vertical axis from 0 to 60 with numbered gridlines at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60 (scale 1 unit = 10 rupees), captioned Price (in rupees per kg).
Twelve month groups along the horizontal axis labelled Jan to Dec, each with two touching columns: green (#009E73) for Yahapur on the left, purple (#CC79A7) for Wahapur on the right.
Yahapur column heights, Jan to Dec: 25, 24, 26, 28, 30, 35, 39, 43, 49, 56, 59, 44.
Wahapur column heights, Jan to Dec: 19, 17, 23, 30, 38, 35, 42, 39, 53, 60, 52, 42.
A legend at the top: a green square labelled Yahapur and a purple square labelled Wahapur.
No numbers are printed on top of the columns.
rejection: a scale other than steps of 10
images.takeaway: Placing the two towns' columns side by side shows in which months each town was costlier.
images.description: A double column graph of monthly onion prices in two towns, green for Yahapur and purple for Wahapur.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Ask students to find a month where the purple column is taller, then one where it is shorter.

image_decisions.why: Students read monthly comparisons from the double column graph.
